# pbs_node_certificates (Data Source)

Lists the certificates of a Proxmox Backup Server node, as the Certificates panel of its interface shows them. PBS has only one: `proxy.pem`, which its web interface and API serve on port 8007 — the self-signed certificate PBS generates, an ACME one, or a custom one. The list gives its fingerprint, subject, validity, DNS names, public key, and the whole PEM file with the chain; the private key, `proxy.key`, is never returned. For the fingerprint alone, `pbs_fingerprint` is simpler.

Needs `Sys.Modify on /system/certificates` — unlike `pbs_node_status`, which shows the fingerprint with `Sys.Audit on /system/status`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pbs_node_certificates" "this" {}

locals {
  # The certificate the web interface and API serve; PBS has no other.
  pbs_certificate = one([for c in data.pbs_node_certificates.this.certificates : c if c.filename == "proxy.pem"])
}

# The certificate and its chain, for clients that verify PBS against a CA
# file rather than by its fingerprint.
output "pbs_certificate_pem" {
  value = local.pbs_certificate.pem
}

# Warn a month before the certificate runs out, and while PBS still serves
# the self-signed certificate it generated.
check "pbs_certificate" {
  assert {
    condition     = timecmp(local.pbs_certificate.not_after, timeadd(plantimestamp(), "720h")) > 0
    error_message = "The PBS certificate expires on ${local.pbs_certificate.not_after}."
  }
  assert {
    condition     = local.pbs_certificate.issuer != local.pbs_certificate.subject
    error_message = "PBS still serves a self-signed certificate for ${join(", ", local.pbs_certificate.san)}."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `node` (String) Node to read: `localhost` or the node's host name. Defaults to the provider's `node`.

### Read-Only

- `certificates` (Attributes List) The node's certificates, ordered by `filename`. PBS 4 lists exactly one, `proxy.pem`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--certificates))

<a id="nestedatt--certificates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `certificates`

Read-Only:

- `filename` (String) File name of the certificate in `/etc/proxmox-backup`: `proxy.pem`.
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate, as PBS shows it and `pbs_fingerprint` reports it: 32 lower-case hexadecimal pairs separated by colons. Null when PBS does not report it.
- `issuer` (String) Issuer of the certificate, in the same form; the same as `subject` for a self-signed one.
- `not_after` (String) End of the certificate's validity, in RFC 3339 format (UTC); null when PBS cannot read it. The certificate PBS generates is valid for 365,000 days.
- `not_before` (String) Start of the certificate's validity, in RFC 3339 format (UTC); null when PBS cannot read it.
- `pem` (String) The whole `proxy.pem` in PEM format: the certificate, followed by its chain when there is one. It holds no private key. Null when PBS does not report it.
- `public_key_bits` (Number) Size of the public key, in bits, such as `4096` for the RSA key of the certificate PBS generates; null when PBS does not report it.
- `public_key_type` (String) Algorithm of the certificate's public key, as OpenSSL names it, such as `rsaEncryption` — the certificate PBS generates has an RSA key — or `id-ecPublicKey` for an elliptic-curve key.
- `san` (List of String) DNS names among the certificate's subject alternative names, in the certificate's order, such as `localhost`, the host name and the fully qualified domain name for the certificate PBS generates. PBS leaves out IP addresses; empty when there are no DNS names.
- `subject` (String) Subject of the certificate, as PBS shows it: `<field> = <value>` entries separated by commas, such as `O = Proxmox Backup Server, OU = <UUID>, CN = pbs.example.com` for the certificate PBS generates.
